title: feat: sync Polli updates from production
author: Itachi-1824

gist.summary: Polli switches to GPT-6.1-Sol and queues follow-up messages. It can reply to requests separately or together with clear user mentions, and can acknowledge messages or respond with one or more emoji reactions through its existing reply flow. Mixed-user batches remain read-only, with each requester's permissions isolated. The update also refreshes Polli's conversational style, lookup recovery, and guidance on the official and community model catalogs.

image.prompt: In a cozy garden hackerspace, Polli sorts little pixel chat bubbles into separate and combined reply trays beside a glowing lime green (#ecf874) CRT, with emoji tokens and code-plants on the desk. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she wears tiny headphones and stays small within the scene. Strictly pixel art style, never realistic; cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes.
